label: WRONG
reason: All 29 guide MDX pages (auth, getting-started, self-hosting/auth/config) build generateMetadata with genGuideMeta, which needs GuideFrontmatter, but the app/** scope also holds unlisted page files whose generateMetadata is legitimately different: the home page and reference/[...slug] (generateReferenceMetadata), plus ai-prompts/[slug] (its own thin helper, worth a look); 1 of 3 counted, so new non-guide pages would get false alarms. The wording 'functions' really means generateMetadata exports. Hesitated with ACCEPT had the scope been guide pages only.
